transactions.citation: p91 Consolidated Statement of Total Return / p100 subsidiary-disposal Note B: 'Gain on disposal of subsidiary S$7,309k'; sale consideration S$140,720k, net identifiable assets divested S$130,471k, realisation of translation reserves S$2,940k.
transactions.sale_price_citation: p171/p796: 'CLCT has on 6 Dec 2023 announced the divestment of CapitaRetail Beijing Shuangjing Real Estate Co., Ltd., which holds CapitaMall Shuangjing at the agreed property price of RMB842.0 million'; p1502/p4859 portfolio table shows RMB842.0m agreed value vs RMB156.9m/156,907k carrying value.
transactions.notes: Structured as disposal of subsidiary (CapitaRetail Beijing Shuangjing Real Estate Co., Ltd.) holding CapitaMall Shuangjing, a Beijing retail mall. Announced 6 Dec 2023, completed 23 Jan 2024 at agreed property price RMB842.0m (exit yield 2.8%); agreed price equalled the appraised value at classification to held-for-sale (RMB842.0m = S$156.9m, p91/p100). sale_price above is the PROPERTY-level agreed price (RMB842.0m); the equity/share consideration actually received by CLCT for the subsidiary was S$140,720k (net identifiable assets divested S$130,471k, gain on disposal of subsidiary S$7,309k, translation reserve realised S$2,940k) - this is a different, subsidiary-equity-level figure and is NOT the sale_price field. gain_loss_pct DERIVED as (sale consideration S$140,720k - net identifiable assets divested S$130,471k)/S$130,471k = 7.86%, using net_identifiable_assets basis because this was an equity/subsidiary disposal, not a direct asset sale. This differs from the AR's disclosed gain figure (S$7,309k) which nets in a S$2,940k translation-reserve realisation not part of the identifiable-assets comparison; both figures are audited (p91, p100) and kept as-is per invariant against balancing by assumption. Investment-property carrying value at the subsidiary level was S$156,570k (Note B, p100) - this is the whole-property carrying value, not on the same interest basis as the S$140,720k equity consideration, so it was NOT used as the reference (per SPEC rule: never mix a part-price with a whole-asset reference / must be on the same interest basis). | BASIS CHANGED 2026-08-03: was net_identifiable_assets 130,471,000 SGD — an entity-level figure the AR gives only in SGD, not comparable with the RMB price. Now the property-level appraised value, which the AR states EQUALLED the agreed price (RMB842.0m = S$156.9m, p91/p100), so the property-level premium is 0%. The REIT's booked accounting gain of S$7,309k (= consideration S$140,720k − net identifiable assets S$130,471k + recycled FX reserves S$2,940k) is an ENTITY-level result and is not reproducible from property-level figures.
